title: Exploring Collatz Dynamics with Human-LLM Collaboration
summary: We present a comprehensive structural analysis of the Collatz conjecture through ~1014 computational experiments yielding 630 formal results. By systematically deploying 29 distinct mathematical paradigms--including transfer operator spectral theory, S-unit equations, p-adic interpolation, martingale methods, modular sieving, formal language theory, cascade algebra, discrete logarithm obstruction, and Diophantine approximation--we establish a Paradigm Exhaustion Theorem: every known framework for promoting distributional convergence ("almost all orbits descend") to pointwise convergence…
